title: 王宫 A · great hall and keep
subject: a real 13th century royal palace photographed from a raised three-quarter view, a long rectangular great hall of grey limestone ashlar under a plain steep dark slate roof with a row of tall pointed windows down its flank, a square stone keep tower rising at one end with a flat crenellated parapet, a lower plain wing returning at right angles to enclose a courtyard, a simple arched gateway in a low curtain wall, everything severe and unornamented, the walls worn and streaked by rain, the whole building alone on plain white with nothing beneath it

title: 王宫 B · courtyard block
subject: a real 13th century royal palace photographed from a raised three-quarter view, four plain ranges of grey limestone ashlar built round a rectangular courtyard under continuous steep dark slate roofs, a square gatehouse with a pointed arch in the near range, a taller hall range at the back with a line of tall windows and two chimney stacks, plain square corner turrets with flat parapets, no decoration of any kind, the masonry weathered and lichened, the whole building alone on plain white with nothing beneath it

title: 王宫 C · hall, chapel and tower
subject: a real 13th century royal palace photographed from a raised three-quarter view, a broad stone great hall with a plain steep dark slate roof, a small chapel with a narrow pointed east window abutting one side, a square residential tower of three storeys with small square windows and a flat crenellated top, a low walled yard with a plain arched gate, all of it grey limestone ashlar, sober and severe with no ornament, weathered stone with real masonry courses, the whole building alone on plain white with nothing beneath it
